questions.cardText:
[Political Science] What was the main goal of England’s continental policy during the 18th century?
A. To prevent any single power from dominating mainland Europe
B. To expand its colony in North America
C. To establish a strong military alliance with Russia
Answer: A. This policy, also known as the Balance of Power, aimed to strategically support weaker countries against any nation that threatened to become too powerful while Britain expanded overseas. This approach often led Britain to intervene in continental wars despite not having direct territorial interests.
questions.de: Unter welchem Namen ist die britische Politik des 18. Jahrhunderts bekannt, schwächere Staaten gegen jede Nation zu unterstützen, die das europäische Festland zu beherrschen drohte?
questions.en: By what name is the 18th-century British policy known of backing weaker states against any nation that threatened to dominate mainland Europe?

timeline.labelEn: The Peace of Utrecht explicitly invokes the balance of power in Europe
timeline.labelDe: Der Frieden von Utrecht beruft sich ausdrücklich auf das Gleichgewicht der Kräfte in Europa

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed. Minor card slip: after the 1707 Union the state is Great Britain, not England (the card's own explanation switches to Britain).

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] In the most recent decades, which country has the most active volcanoes?
A. Japan B. United States C. Indonesia
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welches Land hatte seit 1960 die meisten aktiven Vulkane?
questions.en: Which country has had the most volcanoes active since 1960?

timeline.labelEn: Since 1960 Indonesia has had more active volcanoes than any other country (55 as of 2023)
timeline.labelDe: Seit 1960 hatte Indonesien mehr aktive Vulkane als jedes andere Land (55, Stand 2023)

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed for volcanoes active since 1960 (Indonesia 55, Japan 40, US 39, as of 2023). Counted by all Holocene volcanoes the United States has the most (165), so the question pins 'active since 1960'.
